newsitem.title: UK: Anagen in talks to raise cash via placement.
newsitem.headline: Anagen in talks to raise cash via placement.

text.p: Anagen Plc, manufacturer of automated immunodiagnostic analysis systems, said it is in talks to raise money via a private placement of convertible loan stock.

The biotech firm said it intended to make an announcement as soon as possible on progress with potential marketing partners for its AuraFlex system, as well as the placement, both of which were essential to its future.
The company said it noted the fall in its share price, which hit a new low for the year of 22.5 pence on Wednesday, down 10 pence from Tuesday.
Last year Anagen made a pretax loss of 1.75 million stg.
